evidence: Same lead authors, collaborating NASA and USAF laboratories, and matching published low-pressure, suited and staged profile examples. The older report has 30 profiles and 58 mild-symptom outcomes in 548 exposures. The later chapter has 49 profiles and 201 mild-to-moderate pain-only cases in 923 exposures. Exposure linkage and exact nesting remain unverified.
